content.value_statement: Marketing teams need polished images that fit each channel and load quickly. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan, generate, edit, and optimize visual assets with practical workflow guidance.
actual_capabilities: Chooses suitable workflows for blog heroes, social graphics, banners, mockups, and brand assets.
Compares image generation tools such as Gemini, Flux, Ideogram, GPT Image, Midjourney, Recraft, and Stable Diffusion.
Provides structured prompt patterns for image generation with subject, setting, style, lighting, composition, and technical details.
Lists common dimensions for social platforms, profile banners, product listings, and OG images.
Guides image optimization with format choices, compression targets, lazy loading, dimensions, CDN use, and alt text.
Recommends real screenshots instead of AI-generated product UI when accuracy matters.
limitations: Does not generate images by itself unless the user connects or uses an external image tool.
Cannot guarantee brand consistency without reference assets, style guides, or manual review.
Does not replace a designer for logos, final brand systems, or complex visual identity work.
Command examples require user review before running on local files or websites.

use_cases.title: Plan blog hero images
use_cases.description: Turn a post topic into a visual concept, prompt, dimensions, and optimization checklist.

use_cases.title: Prepare social graphics
use_cases.description: Choose platform sizes and create a repeatable workflow for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook assets.

use_cases.title: Improve product visuals
use_cases.description: Use real screenshots, device frames, annotations, and web optimization for accurate product marketing images.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple blog hero
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one marketing image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a blog hero image for a post about [topic]. Recommend a visual concept, dimensions, image model, prompt, and web optimization steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a social image set
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for multi-platform social graphics.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need one campaign image adapted for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram feed, Instagram Stories, and Facebook. Give me dimensions, crop guidance, and the fastest production workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Build a product mockup workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for accurate product visuals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workflow for marketing images that show our real app UI. Include screenshot capture guidance, device framing, annotations, export sizes, and optimization checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a scalable OG image system
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for programmatic image production.
prompt_templates.prompt: We publish [number] pages per week and need branded OG images for each page. Recommend a template-based system, required metadata, image dimensions, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: I need a hero image for a post about email deliverability.
output_examples.output: A clear concept such as signals passing through an inbox filter, a 1200x630 target size, a model recommendation, a structured generation prompt, and WebP optimization steps.

output_examples.input: Generate an image of our app dashboard.
output_examples.output: A refusal to invent the UI with AI, followed by a workflow using real screenshots, device frames, labels, and export guidance.

output_examples.input: What image format should our site use?
output_examples.output: A recommendation to use WebP with JPEG or PNG fallback, plus resizing, compression, lazy loading, explicit dimensions, CDN, and alt text guidance.

best_practices: Start with the channel, dimensions, and business goal before choosing a generation or design tool.
Use real product screenshots for UI claims, then add frames, labels, and overlays after capture.
Optimize every final image for size, format, layout stability, accessibility, and social preview metadata.
anti_patterns: Do not ask AI image models to invent exact product screens or dashboards.
Do not generate one image and publish it across platforms without checking crop and safe zones.
Do not ship large uncompressed images without WebP or AVIF planning and fallback formats.

faq.question: Can this skill generate images directly?
faq.answer: It provides workflows, prompts, model guidance, and optimization advice. Actual image generation requires a connected image model or design tool.

faq.question: Which tools does it recommend for AI image generation?
faq.answer: It compares Gemini, Flux, Ideogram, GPT Image, Midjourney, Recraft, and Stable Diffusion for different marketing image needs.

faq.question: Can I use it for product screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes, but it recommends capturing real screenshots instead of generating fake UI. This keeps product visuals accurate.

faq.question: Does it cover social media dimensions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes sizes for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Product Hunt, GitHub previews, and other common placements.

faq.question: Does it help with image performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG, SVG, compression, resizing, lazy loading, explicit dimensions, CDN use, and alt text.

faq.question: Is this suitable for brand identity work?
faq.answer: It can support concepts and supporting graphics. Final logos and core brand systems still need design review.
